snippet.title: Homeostasis - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3748480/Homeostasis/

Homeostasis is a short atmospheric survival horror game set in a remote Antarctic research zone. You are deployed alone in a rugged research vehicle, sent to recover abandoned scientific data that could help humanity determine whether the region is truly habitable.

Maintain your vehicle, manage fuel and temperature, and minimize exposure to the brutal Antarctic elements. Survive long enough to complete your assignment and maybe you'll make it back alive.

#horrorgaming #trailer #indiegame #indiehorror
